item.title: Area Girls Hoopsters Lose in Final - 104.9 & 1050 WFSC The Smoky's Classic Hits Station
item.description: The Robbinsville Lady Black Knights fell short in yesterday’s state championship game class 1A in Winston-Salem. The Knights lost 58-44 to Wilson Prep. Robbinsville finishes the season 17-12.

item.title: Franklin Panther Baseball Moved to Monday - 104.9 & 1050 WFSC The Smoky's Classic Hits Station
item.description: The conference opener for the Panthers has been moved to this Monday March 16th as they host East Henderson. The Panthers 4-1 look to get off to a strong start in conference and action can be heard on 104.9 and 1050 WFSC airtime 655pm.

item.title: Lady Braves Win Third Straight State Title in Hoops! - 104.9 & 1050 WFSC The Smoky's Classic Hits Station
item.description: The Cherokee girls basketball team capped off an amazing season with a 76-15 thrashing of Pamlico County this afternoon in Winston-Salem. Cherokee finishes the season with a 29-1 record and a third straight state title. Pamlico finishes the season at 26-3. Over the last three seasons Cherokee has amassed a record of 86-4. Junior Madison Rogers named most outstanding player.

item.title: Swain Baseball and Softball Sweep Murphy - 104.9 & 1050 WFSC The Smoky's Classic Hits Station
item.description: Swain County improved to 2-3 in baseball Friday as they topped Murphy 4-3. Swain is at Cherokee on Monday. Meanwhile the softball team improved to 6-0 following a 14-12 victory over Murphy. Next game is at Smoky Mountain Wednesday. Other scores from Friday: (Baseball) AC Reynolds 6 Smoky Mountain 2. Smoky 3-2 on the season will host Pisgah Tuesday.

item.title: Franklin and Cherokee Postpone Sporting Events - 104.9 & 1050 WFSC The Smoky's Classic Hits Station
item.description: The Franklin Panther Baseball game with East Henderson has been cancelled today due to the snowy weather and cold temps. No make-up date has been announced. Meanwhile the Cherokee Baseball game has been cancelled as well.

item.title: Cold Temperatures Force Delays - 104.9 & 1050 WFSC The Smoky's Classic Hits Station
item.description: The cold and icey temperatures around the area has forced delays for Tuesday March 17th. Macon County along with Highlands and Nantahala Schools are operating on a three hour delay this morning. Cherokee, Jackson and Swain County Schools are operating on a two hour delay today. SCC except the public safety training center will open at 10am.
